item.title: Set Your Rates: A Step-by-Step Pricing Guide for Solo Creators
item.description: A plain-language written guide, read in your browser on Gumroad, that walks a solo creator through working out a starting rate for their services and explaining it to clients.

item.title: Unpaid Invoice Follow-Up Worksheets for Local Service Businesses
item.description: A set of printable worksheet pages and polite reminder wording to help small local service businesses track overdue invoices and follow up on them consistently.

item.title: The Lost Word Library: A System-Agnostic One-Shot Adventure for One Evening
item.description: An original, system-agnostic tabletop role-playing one-shot in which apprentice archivists must recover the words vanishing from a magical library, written to be run in a single evening by a classroom group or a game night table.

item.title: Puzzle & Trivia Pack: Logic, Riddles and Word Games
item.description: A pen-and-paper pack of logic puzzles, riddles, word games and trivia rounds, with a separate answer key so you can check your work.

item.title: River Bend Stories: Three Complete Short Speculative Tales
item.description: A collection of three original, self-contained speculative stories about ordinary people in a small river town, each with a complete ending.

item.title: Student Budget Guide: Plan Your Money on a Small Income
item.description: A practical written guide with worksheet pages that helps students plan a monthly budget, track everyday spending, and set aside a small amount for savings.

item.title: Shop Reorder Worksheets: Count Stock, Set Reorder Points, Plan Orders
item.description: A set of worksheet pages and a short written guide that help small independent shops count stock, set reorder points, and decide what to order next.
